parts.name: Tread bracket, open side
parts.bends: 2 bends, both 90 deg toward the outside face: flange off the front edge, seat tab off the top edge
parts.notes: every other tread (3 lower + 7 upper); west side of the upper flight, north side of the lower flight. 2 x 7/16 bolt holes into the stringer, flange bolt slotted. Drill the seat tab screw holes at assembly.

parts.name: Tread bracket, wall side (mirror)
parts.bends: 2 bends, both 90 deg toward the outside face: flange off the front edge, seat tab off the top edge
parts.notes: mirror image of the open side part. every other tread (3 lower + 7 upper).

parts.name: Tread bracket with slab foot, open side
parts.bends: 3 bends, all 90 deg toward the outside face: flange off the front edge, seat tab off the top edge, foot off the bottom edge
parts.notes: lower flight first tread; west side of the upper flight, north side of the lower flight. 2 x 7/16 bolt holes into the stringer, flange bolt slotted. Drill the seat tab screw holes at assembly.

parts.name: Tread bracket with slab foot, wall side (mirror)
parts.bends: 3 bends, all 90 deg toward the outside face: flange off the front edge, seat tab off the top edge, foot off the bottom edge
parts.notes: mirror image of the open side part. lower flight first tread.

parts.name: Tread strip (2 in on edge, closes the riser)
parts.bends: 2 bends, 90 deg: a screw tab at each end folds toward the back of the tread
parts.notes: one under every tread. 2 x 7/16 holes for the bracket flange bolts. Drill the tab screw holes at assembly. Tabs 1.6 in outside (CAD shows 1.5).

parts.name: Lower stringer head angle, 3 x 3 x 4 in
parts.notes: one each side of the lower stringer's top end; the vertical leg's two holes take through bolts across the stringer, the other leg bolts up through the landing header (through bolt, crush sleeve).

parts.name: Upper stringer top clip, west side
parts.bends: 1 bend, 90 deg (west and east are mirror images)
parts.notes: tube leg hole is a 1 in VERTICAL SLOT: one through bolt across the stringer (crush sleeve inside). Other leg bolts through the balcony head beam.

parts.name: Upper stringer top clip, east side
parts.bends: 1 bend, 90 deg (west and east are mirror images)
parts.notes: tube leg hole is a 1 in VERTICAL SLOT: one through bolt across the stringer (crush sleeve inside). Other leg bolts through the balcony head beam.

parts.name: Upper stringer foot clip, west side
parts.bends: 1 bend, 90 deg (west and east are mirror images)
parts.notes: tube leg sits outside the first upper tread bracket's web; one through bolt clip, web, stringer, web, clip. Other leg through the landing's north beam. CHECK: along the bend the tube leg is only 3/4 in outside (SendCutSend wants 1.36 in); widen that neck if it clears.

parts.name: Upper stringer foot clip, east side
parts.bends: 1 bend, 90 deg (west and east are mirror images)
parts.notes: tube leg sits outside the first upper tread bracket's web; one through bolt clip, web, stringer, web, clip. Other leg through the landing's north beam. CHECK: along the bend the tube leg is only 3/4 in outside (SendCutSend wants 1.36 in); widen that neck if it clears.

parts.name: Upper stringer post saddle (level seat, legs down the post)
parts.bends: 2 bends, 90 deg, both legs down the same way (a U over the post top)
parts.notes: seat 4.50 x 3.50 in outside, legs 3 in wide, 3.75 in outside. One 3/8 through bolt across the post through both legs. The CAD's 3/8 in upturned seat lips are LEFT OFF: too short to bend at SendCutSend (1.36 in minimum); the foot clips hold the tube sideways.

parts.name: Foot post base plate, 6 x 6 (post passes through)
parts.notes: lower flight foot post; the 2 x 2 post stands through the square hole on the slab. COUNTERSINK the two 13/32 in holes from the BOTTOM face (82 deg, 3/8 flat head): flat head screws up through the plate into the post clips, nuts on top (no tapped threads). Four 1/2 in holes for 3/8 in slab anchors.

parts.name: Corner newel base plate, 6 x 6
parts.notes: corner newel stands on it. COUNTERSINK the two 13/32 in holes from the BOTTOM face (82 deg, 3/8 flat head): flat head screws up through the plate into the post clips, nuts on top (no tapped threads). Four 1/2 in holes for 3/8 in slab anchors.

parts.name: Upper stringer post base plate, 7 x 7
parts.notes: 3 x 3 post under the upper stringer's foot. COUNTERSINK the two 13/32 in holes from the BOTTOM face (82 deg, 3/8 flat head): flat head screws up through the plate into the post clips, nuts on top (no tapped threads). Four 1/2 in holes for 3/8 in slab anchors.

parts.name: Balcony post L plate (south west newel and north west post)
parts.notes: flat; the long leg bolts to the end beam of the balcony frame, the short leg up the post. Same part both posts (flip one).

parts.name: Clip angle 2 in wide, 1 3/4 legs
parts.notes: PLACEHOLDER for an engineer: 16 at the landing and balcony frame corners, 6 at the three post bases (2 each, flat heads up through the base plates), 8 at the two knee braces' ends (the south brace's wall end needs a bracket rated about 920 lb: engineer).

parts.name: Rail end clip 1 1/4 in wide, 1 1/2 legs
parts.notes: PLACEHOLDER for an engineer: straight rail ends into post faces, the north guard rail into the west one, the north guard rail at the bath 1 wall, and the four guard bottom rail ends. 9/32 in holes for 1/4-20.

parts.name: Rail to post strap 1 1/4 x 4 1/2
parts.notes: PLACEHOLDER for an engineer: flat strap on the side where a rail runs over a post top (lower rail on the foot post, guard top rails on the north west and north east posts); 1/4 in spacer behind it on the rail, which sits 1/4 in in from the post face.
